subject: Re: Unexpected back-bill & VAT allocation — sequence-hash duplication
messages:
From: Eva Müller <eva@sequencelabs.de>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@sequencelabs.de
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: Unexpected back-bill on June invoice (possible seqhash duplication)

Hi Rafael,

We just received our June invoice and there is a back-billed line for ~1.2M tokens dated 2026-06-15 that wasn’t in the mid-month estimate. Our finance team flagged this as it affects VAT reporting for June (EU reverse-charge). We only had one production deployment active — the sudden spike looks like repeated replayed requests.

Can you:
- Confirm what triggered the back-bill and provide raw request ids or sequence hashes.
- Confirm whether VAT for that charge should be applied to our EU entity (we’re in Germany) or reversed.
- Share usage export and any proof of duplicate ingestion.

I’ve attached the billing CSV from our side for reference (seq-usage-export-202606.csv). We need to resolve before month-end close — finance is asking for evidence of duplication or a credit.

Thanks,
Eva Müller
Head of Finance, Sequence Labs GmbH
[attachment: seq-usage-export-202606.csv (text/csv)]

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Eva Müller <eva@sequencelabs.de>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 18:21:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Unexpected back-bill on June invoice (possible seqhash duplication)

Hi Eva — thanks for raising this and sorry for the surprise. I’m escalating immediately to billing and engineering to get a root-cause and the artifacts you requested. Initial notes:

- I’ve flagged the back-billed line for manual review (internal ticket #RD-BILL-7421).
- Asking infra to pull sequence-hash manifests and request IDs for the 2026-06-14 through 2026-06-16 window.
- David, can you confirm temporary hold on collections for this invoice while we investigate VAT allocation?

Eva — can you also share the HubSpot deal id or your PO number if available? That helps match account entities.

I’ll follow up within 24 hours with logs and a proposal (credit or corrected invoice).

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0132

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:03:00 +0200
Subject: Fwd: Unexpected back-bill — seqhash duplication candidate (RD-BILL-7421)

Marissa / David / Ben — looping you in. Eva reports a ~1.2M token back-bill on 2026-06-15 for Sequence Labs. Attachments: seq-usage-export-202606.csv from customer.

Quick context: usage shows a burst that looks like sequence-hash duplication (replayed requests resulting in duplicate token billing). Engineering, please pull: redwood-usage-log-20260628.jsonl for that tenant and the seqhash manifests. Prioritize correlation by request-id, client-ip, and seq-hash.

Please respond with:
- Candidate root cause (ingest replay, retry-bomb, or client-side resubmission)
- Whether a retroactive credit is appropriate (and how to compute token overlap)
- VAT treatment recommendation for EU entity if we credit vs. reissue invoice (David)

Tagging Ben for any sales/contract implications (PO, term for credits).

Thanks — Rafael

From: Eva Müller <eva@sequencelabs.de>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: billing@sequencelabs.de
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:47:00 +0200
Subject: Re: Unexpected back-bill on June invoice (possible seqhash duplication)

Thanks for the quick response. We pulled some logs from our side and attached a gzipped export of the request sequence-hashes for the same window (seq-seqhash-proof-202606.gz). Our engineering team saw repeated retries due to a transient 503 from our proxy between 09:15–09:25 UTC on 2026-06-15; they attempted resubmissions which may have created duplicate server-side ingestion.

We’ve also included our internal PO: PO-77821 and HubSpot deal link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9631. Happy to set a short call if helpful.

[attachment: seq-seqhash-proof-202606.gz (application/gzip)]

Best,
Eva

From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Eva Müller <eva@sequencelabs.de>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, david_kim@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:04:00 +02:00
Subject: Resolution & proposed credit — Sequence Labs (RD-BILL-7421)

Eva / Team — thanks for the artifacts and patience. Summary and next steps below.

Summary of findings (short):
- Engineering correlated Sequence Labs' seq-hash list with our ingress logs (redwood-usage-log-20260628.jsonl). A set of 1,198,432 tokens were replayed due to duplicate requests originating from the same client-ip and identical sequence-hash values between 09:15–09:25 UTC on 2026-06-15.
- Root cause: transient proxy 503 on customer side led to retries. Server accepted both original and retry; we currently bill per accepted request.

Proposal to resolve:
1) Offer a retroactive credit of 1,198,432 tokens (applied as a negative line on the July invoice).
2) Reissue corrected June invoice (if Sequence Labs prefers a corrected historic invoice) — David, please advise VAT netting vs reissue for EU reverse-charge.
3) Process: we’ll:
   - Apply credit immediately to July (visible in the customer ledger).
   - If customer requests reissued June invoice, we’ll generate a corrected invoice with VAT adjustment and a DocuSign approval for accounting.

David: recommendation? If we credit July, Sequence Labs will record the adjustment in July; if they need June correction for statutory reporting we should reissue invoice with negative line + VAT reallocation.

Eva, next steps from your side:
- Confirm preference: Credit (applied July) OR Reissued June invoice with VAT correction.
- If reissue, confirm PO-77821 and sign DocuSign (link below).

I’ve prepared a DocuSign record for reissue approval in case you need it: https://www.docusign.com/REC-2026-SEQLABS-9631.

Apologies again for the disruption — we’ll update our server-side dedup hints to avoid counting accepted retry windows in the future (engineering will add a 30s seqhash debounce for identical client-ip+seqhash).

Regards,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[attachment: redwood-usage-log-20260628.jsonl (application/jsonl)]
